import re

def parse_log_line(log_line):
    pattern = r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2},\d{3}) \[(.*?)\] (INFO|WARNING|ERROR) (.*?): (.*)'
    match = re.match(pattern, log_line)
    if match:
        timestamp = match.group(1)
        level = match.group(3)
        message = match.group(5)
        return {
            'timestamp': timestamp,
            'level': level,
            'message': message
        }
    else:
        return None
